visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a grey Columbia hoodie and a brown cap speaks directly to the camera while standing outdoors near a modern building pillar. (2) The same man holds a square takeaway container of stinky tofu in front of a brick building background, showing the food to the lens. (3) Scene shifts to an indoor studio/office where the man holds up two boxes of TOMMI branded rice burgers, presenting them excitedly. (4) Close-up shots of hands on a blue cutting board, slicing a cucumber into strips and then cutting a piece of deep-fried stinky tofu in half. (5) The man assembles a rice burger on a white plate, layering cucumber, stinky tofu, and pickled cabbage between two circular rice buns. (6) He pours a dark sauce from a packet over the filling and completes the burger by placing the top bun. (7) The man takes a large bite of his DIY tofu burger, chewing with an expressive face; then, a woman in an office setting is shown taking a bite of the same burger. (8) Transition to the man in a kitchen, placing a packaged burger into a microwave and closing the door. (9) He takes a heated TOMMI pepper cake flavored rice burger out of the microwave and shows the steaming filling containing meat and green onions. (10) The man eats the commercial rice burger and gives a thumbs up; he then presents a burger to another man in a black hoodie. (11) The two men sit together in the office studio, both eating and discussing the food while holding the product. (12) The video ends with a close-up of the product packaging and the man pointing at the camera for a call to action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-arousal male narration begins over an upbeat acoustic-pop BGM. The speaker's pitch variability is high, conveying excitement. (2) A sharp percussive 'click' and 'whoosh' SFX transition the audio as the BGM shifts to a light, plucked string arrangement. (3) Rhythmic cutting sounds (foley-style) match the visual of preparation, followed by a comedic 'ding' and bubble-pop sound effects as text appears. (4) An operatic female vocal swell (soprano) plays dramatically as the speaker bites into the food, creating a mock-epic atmosphere. (5) Mechanical clicking of a microwave door and a 'beep' signal a scene transition; narration remains rapid and enunciated. (6) Another crunching sound effect is heard during the second tasting session, accompanied by a major-key orchestral swell. (7) Ambient room tone is briefly audible under the dialogue between two men before the outro BGM, a bright synthesizer jingle, concludes the track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> DIY Challenge -> Comparison -> Product Endorsement -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote TOMMI's pepper cake flavored rice burger. It does so by showing the creator attempting a difficult DIY 'stinky tofu' rice burger challenge, which is messy and time-consuming, and then comparing it to the convenience and authentic flavor of the microwaveable commercial product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product box, demonstration of microwave preparation, listing of retail channels, and a challenge to another influencer.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy, meme-inspired editing style typical of Taiwanese social media creators to blend entertaining personal vlog content with commercial product placement.
